description: Foul smell from tap water in Sector 4 for 3 days. At least 8 families are experiencing diarrhea and vomiting. Municipal authority not responding to complaints despite multiple calls and written complaint submitted on 30 March.
action_taken: PHED notified. Water sampling done. Chlorine dosing increased.

description: Children in our locality (Sarthana area) developed diarrhea after drinking water from the community well. 3 children admitted to hospital. Well water appears brownish and we have stopped using it.
action_taken: Well sealed temporarily. Health camp organised nearby.

description: Water has turned yellowish after heavy rains yesterday. At least 15 households affected. Some people are developing stomach issues. Reporting from MP Nagar zone. I work as a school teacher and noticed same at school too.
action_taken: Field inspection done. Pipe repair ordered at junction.

description: Strong chlorine smell and slightly cloudy water from taps since morning. No illness yet but concerned about safety. Please check Shastri Nagar area water supply. This is near the old water tank which was repaired 2 weeks ago.
Sewage overflow near tube well in our area. Extremely concerned about water contamination. Local Gram Panchayat informed but no action taken for 2 days. 3 elderly people are seriously ill.
action_taken: Sewage repair done. Tube well disinfected with bleach. 2 ORS camps set up.

description: Water coming from taps has turned slightly yellow with a sulphur-like smell over the past 2 days. Three elderly residents have developed jaundice symptoms. This coincides with industrial work happening near the water main.
action_taken: pH anomaly confirmed. KMC investigating source.

description: 4 families in our building are suffering from stomach upset since yesterday. No visible change in water but all are affected. 4 children have watery diarrhea. Building water tank was cleaned 1 week ago - not sure if properly sanitised.
action_taken: Building tank inspected. Improper sanitisation found. Tank cleaned and disinfected.

description: Water main has burst near open nullah in Dharavi Sector 5. People are forced to use water near the nullah. 11 families affected. Already 6 children and 2 elderly admitted to Sion Hospital.
action_taken: Pipe repaired. Emergency water tanker deployed. Health camp run.

description: 6 families in Sikandra Road Colony have stomach pain and vomiting since yesterday. The water looks normal but taste has changed slightly. We are from lower income group and cannot afford bottled water.
action_taken: Sample collected. Local PHC team visited. ORS distributed.

description: Municipal water supply has been shut off for 3 days without notice in Hazratganj. People are buying water at high prices. Some are using unknown sources. Please resume supply and prevent people from using unsafe sources.
Water from Pune Municipal Corporation taps appears slightly cloudy today after recent heavy rains upstream. Just reporting as precaution. Water usually clean in our area.
Community hand pump water has turned green and smells rotten. Large number of people including children are sick with diarrhea. This is our only water source. We have no money to buy water.
action_taken: Hand pump sealed. Tanker water arranged. ORS + medical camp.

description: Just noticed water pressure was very low this morning and for 10 minutes it came out brownish. Then it cleared. Reporting as precaution. Area is near road construction.
action_taken: BWSSB informed for inspection.

description: 12 families in Lanka Chowk have members with diarrhea vomiting and dehydration since 2 days. We contacted the hospital and learned that many people from this area came with similar complaints. Related to water supply?
action_taken: Water sample collected. PHC camp activated. Oral rehydration kits distributed.

description: People living near Matla river are using river water directly for drinking as no other source available. Large scale diarrhea outbreak. 5 people admitted to Diamond Harbour Hospital.
action_taken: Emergency tanker water deployed. 3 ORS camps activated. RDT cholera testing done.

description: Water has a slight metallic taste since yesterday. One elderly person has mild stomach ache. Just checking if it's safe.
4 neighbouring families all have diarrhea and fever since past 2 days. All use WATCO piped water. No visible problem with water but we all stopped using it after getting sick.
action_taken: Sample collected. Chlorination restored. Health visitor deployed.

description: Brahmaputra overflow has mixed with drinking water points in Uzanbazar. We are not drinking it but requesting emergency tanker supply immediately. Children and elderly at high risk.
action_taken: Emergency tankers deployed in 4 hours. Flood response activated.

description: Mild stomach issues in 2 families. Water looks ok. Maybe food related but reporting just in case since same water source.
Canal water distributed by tankers in our area has turned blue-grey with chemical smell after a dyeing unit waste was reportedly dumped near canal. Several persons sick.
action_taken: Dyeing unit identified and sealed. Canal temporarily shut. Fresh tanker arranged.

description: 7 families near Rajwada in my chawl all experienced vomiting and stomach pain during the night same time. We all use same PHED connection. All children have stomach pain. One pregnant woman was also affected.
action_taken: Sample collected. Pregnant woman admitted to MY Hospital. ORS distributed.

description: First flush of water in morning is brownish but clears after 2 minutes running. Happens rarely but today it was more pronounced.
At Sangam ghat large number of pilgrims and locals are sick with diarrhea and vomiting after using Ganga water for ritual and bathing. At least 20 households near ghat affected.
action_taken: Mass ORS camp set up. Mobile water testing unit deployed. DM alerted.

description: Water has an unusually sweet taste in our flat since this morning. Weird because it was always neutral. Just checking if this could be contamination of some kind.
Bengali Tola lane has many sick people. Same symptoms as reported cholera. 5 people are very serious. Please send doctors here too.
action_taken: Rapid response team deployed. ORS + IV therapy started on site.

description: We live near Hooghly river. Water from our informal tap (canal connection) has looked dark yellow for 3 days and smells strongly chemical. Two people have jaundice now.
action_taken: Canal supply disconnected. Tanker arranged. DM notified.

description: Many families in Kidwai Nagar sick with high fever diarrhea and some with jaundice. Talking to neighbours same symptoms since past 1 week. Hospital also getting patients from here.
action_taken: Multiple cases verified at GSVM Medical College. Source investigated.

description: Small flooding near Nashik Road area from Godavari overflow mixing with local hand pump. We stopped using it but fear contamination.
Three persons in my family have fever and extreme body ache after wading through Brahmaputra floodwater last week while evacuating. Doctor suspects leptospirosis but we need confirmation.
action_taken: Referred to GMCH. Leptospira test ordered. Patient PT-0018 linked.

description: Our NGO team visiting Ramna Road found mass diarrhea outbreak. At least 12 families affected. Multiple children showing severe dehydration. Suspect cholera. We have set up ORS stations but need rapid medical support.
action_taken: Rapid response team dispatched. Cholera RDT kits sent by helicopter.
